events.text: Byzantium has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)
Indonesia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Ancestor Worship (+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from [ICON_BUILDING_SHRINE] Shrines)

The Iroquois have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)
Austria has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Earth Mother (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from every Mine and +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith for each [ICON_RES_IRON] Iron resource)
India has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sacred Path (+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Jungle tiles and Lakes. +1 [ICON_FOOD] from Lakes)
The Aztecs have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sacred Waters (+1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from cities on fresh water)

Byzantium has founded the new religion Islam in the holy city of Constantinople:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Voice of Prophets[ENDCOLOR] Great Prophets cost 25% less [ICON_PEACE] Faith. [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Holy Sites[ENDCOLOR] provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Religious Center[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_TEMPLE] Temples provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness, +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +5 [ICON_GOLD] Gold[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Prophet's Legacy[ENDCOLOR] The Holy Site improvement built by a Great Prophet provides +6 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.

Austria has founded the new religion Eastern Orthodoxy in the holy city of Vienna:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Coffers of the Faithful[ENDCOLOR] +1% [ICON_GOLD] Gold in a city for every follower of this religion there, up to a maximum of +15%[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Peace Gardens[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_GARDEN] Gardens provide +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +2 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness in city
